title: Buzz Aldrin a 33rd degree Freemason, per his book

tellings.quote: that well Buzz Aldrin says himself in one of his books that uh he's a 33rd degree Scottish right Freemason.

plain: The Apollo astronaut Buzz Aldrin is said to state, in one of his own books, that he is a 33rd degree Scottish Rite Freemason, the highest rank in one branch of the Freemasons, an old fraternal society. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani says this to Michels on an episode about the Moon, without naming which book. He raises it to tie the space programme to secret societies.
